question: In April 2025, which of the following footballers became the first to reach 900 professional career goals including club and country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cristiano Ronaldo**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Cristiano Ronaldo** became the first footballer to score **900 professional career goals**, including goals scored for both club and country, in April 2025.
 
• The milestone was achieved during his tenure with **Al-Nassr**, the Saudi Arabian club he joined in 2023 after leaving Manchester United.
 
• Ronaldo is widely regarded as one of the greatest football players of all time, consistently breaking records in his illustrious career.
 
• His goals include contributions to clubs such as **Sporting CP, Manchester United, Real Madrid, Juventus, and Al-Nassr**, as well as the Portuguese national team.
 
• As of 2025, Ronaldo remains the all-time leading scorer for the **UEFA Champions League** and the Portuguese national team.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Professional Career Goals:**

 
 
• This statistic encompasses all goals scored in official matches for clubs and national teams, including league games, domestic cups, international tournaments, and qualifiers.
 
• Other notable players nearing this milestone include **Lionel Messi**, who remains a close competitor in terms of career goals.
 
 
 
• **Ronaldo's Career Highlights:**
 
 
• He has won **five Ballon d'Or awards**, recognizing him as the best player in the world.
 
• He holds the record for the most goals scored in a single UEFA Champions League season (17 goals in 2013-14).
 
• Ronaldo is the first player in history to win league titles in **England, Spain, and Italy**.
 
 
 
• **Influence on Modern Football:**
 
 
• Ronaldo's exceptional goal-scoring ability, athleticism, and dedication to fitness have set a benchmark for upcoming footballers.
 
• He is a global icon, with sponsorships from brands like Nike, and has built his own CR7 brand.
 
 
 
• **Al-Nassr and Saudi Pro League:**
 
 
• Ronaldo joined Al-Nassr in 2023, marking a significant shift in his career to the **Saudi Pro League**.
 
• His presence has increased the global visibility of the league and attracted other international players to the region.
